assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one small inventory icon for Depths, a dark gritty dungeon crawler. Slightly elevated three-quarter view, neutral soft light from upper left, muted natural materials, modest edge highlights. One centered isolated object/group filling about 75 percent of a square canvas, generous transparent padding. GENUINELY transparent background. No ground, scenery, vignette, backdrop gradient, label, lettering, symbol, border, magical glow, hands or people. Subject: RAT PELT. A small compact roll of coarse greasy grey-brown fur and hide, bound once with plain flax twine. One open curled end reveals a dull pale-tan leather underside; the short ragged fur edges break the cylindrical outline. Angle the little roll diagonally lower-left to upper-right. Make the furry texture and curled hollow end clear even at tiny size. This is an ordinary prepared trade material, not an animal figure: no head, eyes, paws, tail, blood or wet flesh. Keep it practical and grubby, not a luxurious fur garment.
assets.description: A greasy little hide. The tanner's boy at the camp pays a coin or two for them. (Salvage: sell it at the merchant.)

Subject: GOBLIN-FORGED SCRAP. The pieces overlap loosely into a chunky asymmetrical cluster with one clear square opening from the buckle. Soot-dark hand-forged metal, blunt irregular edges, dull cold highlights, a little ingrained reddish-brown oxidation in seams.
